column1: # Columns (TAB-separated): module file, entry function, argument vectors, and
# optionally the hosts the row runs on (aarch64-macos, aarch64-linux,
# x86_64-macos, x86_64-linux; absent = every JIT host). Vectors are
# ';'-separated, each a ','-separated list of decimal or 0x-hex u64 arguments.
# There is no expected-value column: the trust-ir reference interpreter is the
# oracle. A vector on which it reports UndefinedBehavior is skipped; an entry
# whose every vector is skipped fails the gate.
